params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $src=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeSource'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $src '.git'))){ throw "Canonical source mirror missing: $src" }; $root=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'MhwUiEvidence'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; git -C $src fetch origin --prune; $base=Join-Path $root 'base'; $cand=Join-Path $root 'candidate'; foreach($p in @($base,$cand)){ if(Test-Path $p){ try { git -C $src worktree remove --force $p } catch {}; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; git -C $src worktree add --detach $base f238c429193d037343b0b060ba2e1c06587d5284; git -C $src worktree add --detach $cand 5dab6bd456e96d4087ab21ee460be5f6b06ae60a; dotnet build (Join-Path $base 'src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj') -c Release -p:NuGetAudit=false; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'Base UI build failed' }; dotnet build (Join-Path $cand 'src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj') -c Release -p:NuGetAudit=false; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'Candidate UI build failed' }; $be=(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $base 'src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release') -Filter 'MHW Mod Manager.exe' -Recurse -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName); $ce=(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $cand 'src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release') -Filter 'MHW Mod Manager.exe' -Recurse -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName); Write-Output "BASE_EXE=$be"; Write-Output "CANDIDATE_EXE=$ce"
